description: Use this when the user wants a reverse dns lookup, an ip address lookup for PTR names, or a quick ip lookup of hostnames: it queries DNS-over-HTTPS for the in-addr.arpa or ip6.arpa name of one to twenty public IPv4 or IPv6 addresses and returns host names with a CSV download, without reading a registry. Limits: a PTR name exists only when the network operator sets it; private, loopback, link-local, shared, multicast, documentation and reserved addresses are not queried. Do not use when the user wants the owner, the registration dates or the abuse contact of an address (use lookup_ip for that).

ips.description: One to twenty public IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, separated by commas, spaces, or new lines. Example: 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1, 2606:4700:4700::1111.

name: reverse_dns_lookup
title: Reverse DNS lookup
